messages.content: Include at least one table in Markdown table format. Use Markdown table syntax for tables (pipes + dashed separator row). The final line of your response must be exactly: "Sleeping in a hammock isn't just about comfort.". Do not use any of these words or phrases: ['nature']. Make the total word count exactly 20. (Only English-letter words count; apostrophes inside words are allowed.)

Write a blog post about the benefits of sleeping in a hammock. Use at least 25 words in total. (A "word" is a run of English letters A–Z/a–z; apostrophes inside words like "don't" count as part of the word.) Make sure each of these appears in the response: ['nature']. Do not include any tables. End your response with this exact line: "Sleeping in a hammock isn't just about novelty.".
